result.title: Grounding Across Views: Cross-View Referring Reasoning for Visual Grounding
result.summary: Cross-view object geo-localization (CVOGL) aims to localize a target in a satellite image from an observation captured under another viewpoint. Existing methods typically specify the query with a click point or bounding box, marking the target region but underusing the semantic attributes and relations conveyed by natural language. Moreover, referring expressions are often viewpoint-dependent, making query-view descriptions difficult to ground directly in the satellite image. In this paper, we formulate cross-view visual grounding (CVVG), extending conventional point- or box-prompted CVOGL to instance grounding jointly guided by a referring expression and a visual exemplar. We present GAV (Grounding Across Views), a view-aware framework for selectively transferring visual and linguistic evidence across views. Its core is view-aware referring reasoning: target-centered descriptions are derived from the marked query image, checked for target-category consistency, and augmented with a direction-free role cue. Exemplar prompting, cross-view alignment, and scene-level discrimination ground this semantic evidence in a satellite instance. GAV achieves a new state of the art on MoP-UAV with 62.55% Acc@0.5. We also introduce CVOGL-Text, a benchmark for text-guided grounding from street- and drone-view queries to satellite images. GAV outperforms the click-point baseline by 7.09 and 6.79 Acc@0.25 points on the street- and drone-view splits, respectively, demonstrating robustness to larger viewpoint gaps. The code and annotations will be publicly released.

AI.brief_summary: 论文将跨视角目标地理定位扩展为跨视角视觉 grounding（CVVG），提出 GAV 框架：从带标注的查询图生成以目标为中心的语言描述，做类别一致性校验并加入方向无关的角色提示，再通过 exemplar prompting、跨视角对齐与场景级判别在卫星图像中定位实例，同时发布 CVOGL-Text 基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨视角语言与视觉证据的筛选、一致性校验和对齐流程，可能为 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与跨视图信息保留提供可供核查的方法线索；但论文聚焦下游定位任务，未涉及内部 latent 状态的生成或推理过程分析。
